title: Zesty Crisp Venezuelan Garlic Empanadas
description: Delicate corn husk-wrapped empanadas filled with a zesty garlic and cheese filling, crispy fried to perfection. A romantic and flavorful Venezuelan dish.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine flour, salt, and black pepper. Mix well.
Gradually add water to the flour mixture and knead for 5 minutes to form a dough.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Place a ball of dough between two corn husks and flatten slightly.
In a pan, heat 1/2 cup of oil over medium heat. Fry the empanadas until golden brown.
In a separate pan, heat 1/4 cup of oil over medium heat. Add garlic and onion and sauté until softened.
Add cheddar cheese to the pan and stir until melted. Season with salt and black pepper.
Fill each empanada with the cheese mixture and top with chopped cilantro.
Serve the empanadas hot with a side of salsa or guacamole.
